# slackclient

Small Slack client library for matterircd/matterbridge, modelled on
[matterclient](https://github.com/matterbridge/matterclient) and
[matrixclient](https://github.com/matterbridge/matrixclient). Wraps
[slack-go/slack](https://github.com/slack-go/slack): token/cookie and password
login, RTM connection, conversation/channel and user helpers, and message
posting.
